perFixtureSize.caveat: The source weights have no more than six decimal places, so quantization is exact at the chosen scale. These results show agreement across preprocessing, encoding, local contract calculation, and decoding; they do not establish precision for weights with more decimal places.

categoryAgreement.note: A random integer is chosen with equal probability from 0 through B-1 and added before the score is compared with the category thresholds. A score within B below a threshold can therefore move into the next category. We report agreement for scores outside this range and count the scores inside it separately. Category assignment uses one final score, so it was evaluated with the 100-SNP data. The exact mean random addition is (B-1)/2, or 63.5 when B=128. The integer threshold correction uses B/2, or 64 when B=128.
